top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a prediction (the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model giving flat bands at a magic angle) and the decisive 2018 experiment (Jarillo-Herrero) that found correlated insulating and gate-tunable superconducting states, with all three names inside the credited chain. The phenomena are reproduced by many groups and across moire platforms; the open pairing mechanism bears on citation scope, not on whether the discovery was made. Andrei's omission and the youth of the field are real weaknesses, but P003 has its own forced exclusions (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan) and sits closer to the 2016 topology prize, and P002 refines metrology honoured in 2005 and 2012. Any award is preferred to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; only general Chalmers/WACQT quantum-technology ties, none to the candidates in P001-P003
